name: Mafia
summary: Hidden mafia minority against the town: night kills, day votes.
rules_text: A hidden minority of mafia players tries to outnumber the town. Each night the mafia agree on a victim and a detective learns one player's allegiance. Each day everyone discusses and the town votes someone out, whose role is revealed. The town wins when every mafia player is gone; the mafia win when they equal the town in number.
